notes.title: Demo Update – Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
We've updated the demo with improved tutorials to make the experience clearer and more intuitive. Now it will be easier to understand the game mechanics.

🔹 Improved tutorials for a more intuitive experience.
🔹 Clearer explanations so you don’t get lost while exploring.

If you’ve already tried the demo, give it another shot and let us know what you think! 🎮
